a.text: Founded in 2018 by environmental engineers and business strategists, GreenVolt was born from a simple observation:

Businesses wanted to embrace sustainability but lacked the expertise and roadmap to do so  effectively. What started as a small consultancy helping local businesses install solar Panels has grown into a comprehensive sustainability partner serving 500+ organisations across North America. Our approach combines environmental science, engineering expertise, and business acumen to deliver solutions that benefit both planet and profit. Today, our team of 40+ certified professionals helps companies of all sizes navigate the complex journey to sustainability. From Fortune 500 corporations to family-owned businesses, we've proven that environmental responsibility and financial success go hand in hand.
Our mission is to help businesses grow sustainably. Our vision is a future where companies thrive while making a positive impact on the planet.

a.$control__description: Empower businesses to achieve environmental sustainability through expert consulting, innovative solutions, and measurable impact. We make the transition to net-zero operations accessible, profitable, and permanent.

A world where every business operates in harmony with the environment, where sustainability is not a choice but a standard, and where economic
growth and environmental preservation advance together.

a.text: We are guided by integrity, sustainability, and innovation, creating positive impact for businesses and the planet.

a.$control__description: Every decision we make prioritizes long-term environmental impact over short-term gains. We practice what we preach—our office is 100% solar-powered and carbon-neutral certified.

We rely on data, research, and proven methodologies. All our recommendations 
are backed by environmental science and industry best practices.

No greenwashing, no exaggeration. We provide honest assessments, realistic 
timelines, and transparent reporting on all projects.

The sustainability landscape evolves rapidly. We stay ahead through constant 
learning, technology adoption, and innovation in our methodologies.
